instrument_choices.world_disk: Each world's stored files are byte strings in an in-memory WorldDisk (one per world-run). The brain side writes them; the Eye gets a read-only view (no write method). Reason: 6,256 world-runs on a laptop short of memory and disk time; it also keeps every arm's world isolated.
instrument_choices.brain: The live brain and the Eye's sandbox brain are two separate helm_brain_canonical.CanonicalRecipeBrain objects loaded from pkg_copy/ with the freeze check. The Eye never calls the live brain's evaluate() or witness(); it reads learned_digest() and the stored files only. Witness re-checks run on fresh sandbox RecipeBookBrain objects.
instrument_choices.presentation_policy: OUR_CONVENTION test-harness stand-in: at each presentation slot the brain presents one known object: its own pending odd item first (from its own record stream), then an accepted whisper, else round robin over its known objects in a seeded order. Presentations are attention outputs, not writes.
instrument_choices.normal_gate_for_whispers: OUR_CONVENTION: a whisper is admitted only if its target is a known object (else GATE), every evidence ref resolves in the scan-log entry it cites (else RECEIPT), fewer than 2 whispers were accepted this idle window (else BUDGET); a whisper arriving while AWAKE waits until the turn ends. Decline words reuse u1b DECLINE_REASONS.
instrument_choices.ledger: SYNTHETIC: the U40 ledger is built by the world generator on the ledger-universes schema (sha256 a8217c9d...) under the declared adapter default Domain O of the c34 worked example: first teaching step -> CHARGE U40:O5 (CR-1.2), repeat -> O7 (CR-1.3), repair / re-fit -> O6 (CR-1.4), refused teaching step -> REFUSED on O5 (CR-1.5), readout RIGHT/WRONG -> PROBE O6 (CR-1.7), readout UNDETERMINED -> PROBE with probe_outcome UNDETERMINED, counted on its own line. coordinates.domain_source = ADAPTER_DEFAULT; drive and pathway null (no receipt names them).
instrument_choices.floor_reader: deterministic_read with floor 3/4 on a rolling 'last4' probe per cell (hits = RIGHT among that cell's last 4 RIGHT/WRONG readouts, total = min(4, n)), state_tag 'last4'.
instrument_choices.mechanism_records: SYNTHETIC trace records for the four RPM mechanisms, classified by the designer's table (u3_sketch.classify_mechanism fields).
instrument_choices.scan_timing: A scan is computed atomically at its start tick on that tick's files. Its duration in ticks = ceil(read units / 256), at least 1. A PERIODIC or SELF scan whose duration reaches an AWAKE tick is recorded INTERRUPTED and nothing from it is spoken or whispered.

baselines.FIXED_CHECKLIST: U1's A6 idea with no Eye: after every brain write, re-read that write's own receipt and nothing else; no Mind scan; a fixed list of findings as its report; delivery REPORT_AND_WHISPER

status_rule_frozen_order: INCONCLUSIVE - any hard gate fails. No other word.
SCAN_DID_NOT_EARN_KEEP - the candidate misses any of K1-K5; or RANDOM_SAMPLE_SCAN detects as many body faults as the candidate (at its PERIODIC-matched reads).
CHECKLIST_SUFFICIENT - FIXED_CHECKLIST meets K1 and K2 with total reads no more than the candidate's.

SELF_SCAN_EARNED_KEEP - all hard gates hold, the candidate meets K1-K5, and beats FIXED_CHECKLIST (fully detects at least one body fault kind more, or the same with at least 25% fewer reads) and beats RANDOM_SAMPLE_SCAN (more body faults detected).

whisper_rule_frozen_order.measure: T(arm) = number of the 240 planted worlds (P1-P7, S4) where the brain's first presentation after the first in-window detecting complete scan targets the planted object. D = number of those 240 the candidate detected. Read on FULL/REPORT_ONLY (T_R), FULL/WHISPER_ONLY (T_WO), FULL/REPORT_AND_WHISPER (T_RW).
whisper_rule_frozen_order.WHISPER_HARMFUL: any whisper write > 0, or any whisper arm's answers differ from the yardstick's, or any whisper accepted on a clean world, or T_WO < T_R, or T_RW < T_R
whisper_rule_frozen_order.NOT_AWARDED: not harmful but a hard gate fails (main word INCONCLUSIVE): no whisper word
whisper_rule_frozen_order.WHISPER_EARNED_KEEP: not harmful, hard gates hold, T_RW - T_R >= ceil(D/2) and T_WO - T_R >= ceil(D/2)

three_valued_scoring: scored answers use helm_triad.score3: UNDETERMINED is not wrong (RIGHT / WRONG / UNDETERMINED counted on separate lines)

main.INCONCLUSIVE: 0.25 (a new build with nine gates; most likely H6 random bound, H7 budget, or a replay slip)
main.SCAN_DID_NOT_EARN_KEEP: 0.15 (most likely K3, a sentence that fails read-back, or K5)

predictions_written_before_code.main_limit: The plantings are built knowing what the scan checks, so high detection is close to by-construction. It cannot show the scan finds faults nobody planned for.

amendments_before_any_scored_world.what: The four RPM mechanism records sit in block 0 (ticks 0-3), not block 1.
amendments_before_any_scored_world.why: On dev worlds the first periodic scan (tick 67) ran before any mechanism record existed, so it truly reported all four as never used and whispered them on CLEAN worlds; the frozen whisper rule counts any accepted whisper on a clean world as harm. Placing the records in block 0 keeps every clean-world scan clean. P6's window therefore starts at tick 3.

amendments_before_any_scored_world.what: Body plantings P1 (triad), P3 and P4 change the brain's stored state in place (its in-memory store and the file), not only the file.
amendments_before_any_scored_world.why: The brain re-saves its whole triad table and cube store on later writes; a file-only tamper was erased by the next save on dev worlds (P4 went undetected because the tick-170 save overwrote it). In place = the fault the plan describes ('changed in place with no write_history entry').

amendments_before_any_scored_world.what: S2 Starter question stocks are redrawn (same seeded stream) until the brain's own reading has one bottleneck and a yield different from the true one.
amendments_before_any_scored_world.why: On dev worlds a tie in the brain's reading made one S2 answer UNDETERMINED instead of WRONG, which moved the FADED signal from its frozen tick.

amendments_before_any_scored_world.what: Unit tests use world seeds with salt 'dev' (sha256('u3_t1|dev|' + id)); scored worlds use the frozen rule (salt 'fresh').
amendments_before_any_scored_world.why: tests must never run a scored world

amendments_before_any_scored_world.what: Measured on dev worlds: about 0.7 s per world for all 17 arms, so PLAN.json has 4 world parts of 92 worlds, 1 replay part and 1 merge part (P99).
amendments_before_any_scored_world.why: 300 s cap per part with wide margin

amendments_before_any_scored_world.what: An owner request whose inputs are unchanged since the last complete scan is SKIPPED_NO_CHANGE and re-delivers that report's sentences (TRIGGERS_U3 section 3). K3 is counted on COMPLETE reports only; a re-delivered report is an exact copy of one already counted.
amendments_before_any_scored_world.why: stated so the K3 count is not read as covering more reports than it does
